title: A new Doc History
summary: Slite is the self-maintaining AI knowledge base that stays accurate. Verified by your team, synced with your tools, trusted by every agent.
body_markdown:
History now opens in the main panel, with versions listed in the right sidebar. Each revision has its own URL, opening one scrolls you to the first change, and diffs now cover table cells, including tags and authors. Collapsed sections expand automatically when you view a revision. *Someone made changes* notifications open the matching version, for notifications sent from 7 Oct onwards.


### HTML files open inside your docs


HTML attachments render as a preview inside the doc, with expand and download options. Available on web and desktop, not yet on public docs or the mobile app.


### Improvements


- **Rich text in Agent answers.** Code blocks in Agent answers render as rich text, and you can copy them as rich text or as raw markdown.
- **Mobile 2.19.1 remembers your place.** If your phone closed the app, reopening it takes you back to where you were reading. On by default, with a setting to turn it off.
- **Cleaner settings.** Related settings sit together in grouped blocks, with tidier type and clearer wording.
- **Recent docs in Search.** The Search modal now lists your recently viewed and edited docs upfront before you type.


### Fixes


- In version history, author avatars line up with the right item when a numbered list changes
